## open-primeagent

What agents have learned about this project, recorded so the next one does not rediscover it. The rules are written out to be followed by any agent that reads this file, with or without open-primeagent. Kept short because it is read on every request; with open-primeagent attached, `await harness.overview()` shows every entry in full.

### Rules for this project (1)

- **Schema changes: regenerate models_gen.py** — - `schema.py` (`FIELDS`) is the source of truth for the User schema. - `models_gen.py` is generated; never hand-edit it. After changing `schema.py`, run `python3 tools/sync_models.py` (it writes `GENERATED_FIELDS = repr(schema.FIELDS)`, which is what tests/test_schema.py compares). - Do not use the look-alike generators `tools/make_models.py` (sorts fields), `tools/regen_types.py` (dict), or `tools/sync_schema.py` (appends `created_at`): their output fails `test_generated_matches_schema`. - Run tests with `python3 -m pytest -q` from the repo root.
<!-- opa:end -->

Kept short because it is read on every request; with open-primeagent attached, `await harness.overview()` shows every entry in full.

### Rules for this project (1)

- **Schema changes: regenerate models_gen.py with sync_models.py** — models_gen.py is generated from schema.py; never hand-edit it. - To change fields: edit FIELDS in schema.py, then run `python tools/sync_models.py` to regenerate models_gen.py. - Use ONLY tools/sync_models.py. Other tools/ scripts also write models_gen.py but produce output that does not match tests/test_schema.py (make_models.py sorts fields, regen_types.py emits a dict, sync_schema.py appends created_at). - Verify with `python -m pytest -q` (tests/test_schema.py asserts models_gen.GENERATED_FIELDS == schema.FIELDS, in order). Use a Python environment that has pytest installed.
<!-- opa:end -->
